model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across six medical specialties, comparing a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) against versions fine-tuned on each of the six specialties. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains six categorical groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals. Within each group, seven bars are displayed: a light blue bar representing Mistralv0.2-Base, followed by six bars representing models fine-tuned on Cardio (light yellow), Gastro (light peach/tan), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (darker orange), Obstetrics (dark brown-orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown), as indicated in the legend. Across all six specialty groups, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bar consistently reaches approximately -22, making it the tallest (least negative) bar in every group. The fine-tuned model bars vary in height across groups; for example, in the Cardio group, the fine-tuned bars extend down to approximately -26 to -26.5, representing the most negative values observed in the chart. In the Infect group, the fine-tuned bars are relatively shorter in magnitude, reaching approximately -22.5 to -24. In the Gastro group, the fine-tuned bars range from roughly -23 to -24.5. The Neuro group shows fine-tuned bars reaching approximately -24 to -25. The Obstetrics and Pediatrics groups display fine-tuned bars ranging from approximately -23 to -24.5. No bars appear to be individually annotated or visually emphasized beyond the color coding, and the groups are not sorted by any apparent numerical order but rather listed alphabetically by specialty name.
